name: Relais R-01
geometry: Authored procedurally in vector-fields/build_reference_weapon.py; independent slot meshes, common interfaces.

textures.method: Built-in imagegen tool, opaque 4x4 diffuse atlas
textures.preparation: Equal-cell crop, resize to 256x256, 256-color BMP palette; no hand-painted replacement of generated art.
textures.lens: Original tile 11 glass region is UV-mapped to the rectangular sight. Additive render flag keeps scene visibility. No yellow cross geometry.

animation.base: Existing MP40 hands and nine sequences from generated/weapon_visuals/mp40_rig; archived donor provenance remains in weapon-lab.
animation.new: R01_Bolt socket and authored firing/reload translation track.
animation.retained: Bone76 chassis and Bone71 magazine animation.
